SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (
    SELECT MIN(birth_date)
    FROM client
    WHERE district_id = d.district_id
)
AND d.A11 = (
    SELECT MAX(A11)
    FROM district
)
